Interface STSOidcProviders

All Known Implementing Classes:
STSOidcProvidersImpl
public interface STSOidcProviders
Client interface for managing trusted OIDC providers within a root project (/v1/projects/{projectId}/oidcProviders).

Supports paging the providers of a project (pageOidcProviders), registering a new provider (createOidcProvider), modifying (patchOidcProvider) and permanently removing (deleteOidcProvider) one, and the reversible suspend/resume lifecycle (suspendOidcProvider / resumeOidcProvider).

    • list

      OidcProviderPage list(String projectId, Boolean includeSuspended, String pageToken, Integer pageSize)
      Pages through the OIDC providers of a project, controlling inclusion of suspended providers and pagination.
      Parameters:
      projectId - the project identifier
      includeSuspended - true to include suspended providers, or null for the default
      pageToken - the opaque page token from a prior response, or null for the first page
      pageSize - the maximum number of results per page, or null for the server default
      Returns:
      the requested page of OIDC providers
